scope: Forensic accounting audit of the already selected fixed PumpSwap transaction subset; not a preregistered return test or a new market sample.

selection.source_transactions: All successful getTransaction bodies already retained in data/buyer_probe_20261012/rpc.jsonl
selection.event_identity: PumpSwap BuyEvent or SellEvent discriminator under the exact executing PumpSwap program
selection.deduplication: Identical log and CPI representations count once; repeated identical events count by maximum source occurrence.

tests: Decode complete BuyEvent and SellEvent bodies against the pinned official IDL and require exact byte consumption.
For buy_exact_quote_in variants, test quote_amount_in minus user_quote_amount_in against LP plus protocol plus creator fees.
For buy variants, test user_quote_amount_in minus quote_amount_in against LP plus protocol plus creator fees.
For sells, test quote_amount_out minus user_quote_amount_out against LP plus protocol plus creator fees.
Test buyback_fee as a subdivision of protocol_fee, not an additional user fee.
For the five existing buy route audits, compare instruction-aware gross debit with exact quote-account token outflow.
Recompute concentration and returning-buyer notional descriptively using gross debits; do not change historical eligibility.
post_observation_disclosure: The two approximately 0.45% discrepancies and exploratory complete-event fields were inspected before this plan was written. This is an explanatory forensic audit, not untouched or out-of-sample evidence.
